Finding Limits of Integration in the Order dz dy dx

We evaluate a triple integral by applying a three-dimensional version of Fubini’s Theorem (Section 15.2) to evaluate it by three repeated single integrations. As with double integrals, there is a geometric procedure for finding the limits of integration for these iterated integrals.
